quick_skim.title: Tytan: Interactive Neurosymbolic Construction of Analytic Semantic Schemas from Relational Data
quick_skim.abstract: From natural-language query interfaces to automated report generation, data analysis tools need a description of the data: the real-world entities it contains, which columns function as measures or identifiers, and how tables connect into units of analysis. Today, this semantic layer is usually written by hand. This is a knowledge-acquisition bottleneck that limits the scalability of analytic systems, keeps non-technical users dependent on experts, and is itself error-prone. We present TYTAN, a system for automatically constructing an analytic semantic schema from a relational database and, when available, a short user-provided description. TYTAN combines symbolic analysis of the database with LLM-based semantic inference for entity proposal, role assignment, and naming. When the evidence leaves a decision ambiguous, TYTAN asks the user a targeted natural-language question. We evaluate TYTAN on eight databases spanning real-world and benchmark domains along the three axes that define a schema's functional utility: (i) coverage, are all important entities and features captured?; (ii) retrieval correctness, do the schema's instructions actually reach the data; and (iii) characterization accuracy, are semantic types correct? Across the seven reference domains, TYTAN reaches every entity, attribute, and aggregable feature of the expert-corrected reference schemas (100% coverage). Additionally, 100% of its retrieval instructions execute correctly (1,678 of 1,678 self-generated claims), and semantic roles agree with the reference on 92-100% of matched attributes. Checking the underlying data showed the small disagreement is in the reference, not in TYTAN. On a held-out blind test (a live, ten-table database with no declared keys), TYTAN recovers the full entity structure with verified keys and satisfies 100% of the satisfiable expectations of five independent blind annotators.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: TYTAN automatically builds analytic semantic schemas from relational databases by combining symbolic database analysis with LLM-based semantic inference, reducing manual effort in data analysis systems.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 数据分析系统需要描述数据实体、度量列和表间连接的语义层，但手工编写该层既耗时又易出错，成为可扩展性的瓶颈。本文提出TYTAN系统，将关系数据库的符号分析与大语言模型的语义推断相结合，在可选用户描述的辅助下自动构建分析语义模式。实验显示该方法能有效减少人工知识获取成本，支持自然语言查询和自动化报告生成等下游任务，展示了神经符号方法在表格数据理解中的实用价值。
